title: Restriction to an open and pullback: compatibility of the adjunction units
statement:
Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $W\subseteq X$ an open subscheme and $W'=g^{-1}(W)\subseteq Y$; let $j_W:W\to X$, $j_{W'}:W'\to Y$ be the open immersions (etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]) and $g_W:W'\to W$ the restriction of $g$, so that $g\circ j_{W'}=j_W\circ g_W=:h$. Let inverse images, direct images and units of the small etale sites be as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] ($\eta_u:\mathrm{id}\to u_*u^{-1}$), where $W\times_XY$ is identified with the open subscheme $W'$ of $Y$ (and $W\times_WW'$ with $W'$) by [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product], so that $(g_*H)(W)=H(W')$ for an abelian sheaf $H$ on $Y_{\Et}$ and $\Gamma(W,g_{W*}H')=\Gamma(W',H')$ for one on $W'_{\Et}$. For an abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] let $\kappa_F=c_{g,j_{W'},F}^{-1}\circ c_{j_W,g_W,F}:g_W^{-1}j_W^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}h^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{W'}^{-1}g^{-1}F$, with $c$ the isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] (so $\kappa$ is natural in $F$), and let $\rho_F:j_W^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}F|_W$ and $\rho_{g^{-1}F}:j_{W'}^{-1}g^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}(g^{-1}F)|_{W'}$ be the isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction] (1), so $\rho_F(W):\Gamma(W,j_W^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(W)$ and $\rho_{g^{-1}F}(W'):\Gamma(W',j_{W'}^{-1}g^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\sim}(g^{-1}F)(W')$. Then for every $a\in\Gamma(W,j_W^{-1}F)$,
$$
\rho_{g^{-1}F}(W')\bigl(\kappa_F(W')\bigl(\eta_{g_W,j_W^{-1}F}(W)(a)\bigr)\bigr)=\eta_{g,F}(W)\bigl(\rho_F(W)(a)\bigr)\quad\text{in }(g^{-1}F)(W'),
$$
i.e. the composite $\Gamma(W,j_W^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\eta_{g_W}}\Gamma(W',g_W^{-1}j_W^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\kappa_F}\Gamma(W',j_{W'}^{-1}g^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\rho}(g^{-1}F)(W')$ equals $\Gamma(W,j_W^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\rho_F(W)}F(W)\xrightarrow{\eta_{g,F}(W)}(g^{-1}F)(W')$: under the identifications of the inverse image along an open immersion with the restriction, pulling back sections along $g_W$ is pulling back sections along $g$.

source.place: not stated in the source (agent-identified gap, needed by lem-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-pullback step 4); the setting is that of Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 03F3 (localization and restriction of sheaves). Intended proof (agent): both sides are the $W$-sections of morphisms of sheaves $j_W^{-1}F\to g_{W*}(j_{W'}^{-1}g^{-1}F)$ on $W_{\Et}$ (via $\rho$); by the adjunction $j_W^{-1}\dashv j_{W*}$ they agree once their composites with $\eta_{j_W,F}$ agree, and these are computed on each object $T$ of $X_{\Et}$ with the unit compatibility of $c$ ([lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] (2), for both factorizations of $h$), [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction] (2) (unit = restriction, for $j_W$ and $j_{W'}$) and the naturality of $\eta_g$ along $T\times_XW\to T$: both become $F(T)\to F(T\times_XW)\to(g^{-1}F)(T\times_XW')$.

mathlib_searches.query: pullback of sheaves along a morphism of sites commutes with restriction to an open, compatibility of the adjunction units with the isomorphism of composite inverse images
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: the composition isomorphism of pullbacks of sheaves of modules along continuous functors exists (as a conjugate of the pushforward composition), but no inverse image functor of the small etale site along a morphism of schemes, no identification with restriction for an open immersion, hence not this compatibility
